en.t: As he said this, his delight showed plainly on his face.

units.source_text: 惟光便把明石姬的船被这里的盛况所吓退之事告诉了公子。

en.t: Koremitsu then told the young lord how Lady Akashi's boat had been frightened away by the bustle and splendor here.

units.source_text: 公子吃惊道：“我全然不知呀！”

en.t: The young lord said in surprise, "I knew nothing of it at all!"
He felt deeply sorry for her.

units.source_text: 他回想神明引导他到明石浦之事，便觉这明石姬异常可爱。

en.t: Thinking back on how the gods had guided him to Akashi Bay, he felt that this Lady Akashi was extraordinarily dear to him.

units.source_text: 料想她此时必然悲伤，总须给她一信，以慰其心。

en.t: Imagining that she must surely be grieving now, he felt he must send her a letter to comfort her heart.
